title: Never the Number: Structural Abstention for AI Systems Whose Answers Are Consumed as Fact
abstract: arXiv:2608.13926v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models have made natural language interfaces to databases (NLIDB) newly credible, but LLM text-to-SQL systems fail in a way that matters for deployment: a hallucinated column or a mis-aggregated total yields a fluent wrong answer, indistinguishable at the point of use from a right one. Where the consumer cannot inspect the generated query, as in enterprise AI deployments and operational dashboards, and increasingly where the consumer is a tool-using agent rather than a person, accuracy alone is insufficient: nothing marks which answers to distrust. This is a reliability problem before it is an accuracy problem.   We propose an architectural pattern for such systems, a trusted kernel with a generative shell, resting on one invariant: a component that can fabricate may influence which question the system answers, never which value it returns. translated_title: 永不数字：针对答案被当作事实消费的AI系统的结构性弃权
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13926v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型使自然语言数据库接口（NLIDB）重新变得可信，但LLM文本到SQL系统在部署中会出现一个关键失败：一个虚构的列或一个错误聚合的总数会产生流畅的错误答案，在使用时与正确答案无法区分。在消费者无法检查生成查询的情况下，例如企业AI部署和运营仪表板中，以及越来越多情况下消费者是使用工具代理而非人类时，仅靠准确性是不够的：没有任何标记指示哪些答案不可信。这首先是一个可靠性问题，然后才是准确性问题。我们为这类系统提出一种架构模式，即一个可信内核与一个生成外壳，基于一个不变量：能够捏造内容的组件可能影响系统回答哪个问题，但绝不会影响它返回哪个值。一个生成外壳解释不明确的输入并组织回复；一个确定性...
tldr: 本文提出了一种“可信内核与生成外壳”的架构模式，通过确保生成组件只能影响问题选择而不能影响返回值，解决了LLM文本到SQL系统中虚构答案难以区分的问题，从而提高了可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a "trusted kernel with a generative shell" architecture that ensures generative components can only influence question selection, never returned values, addressing the reliability issue of indistinguishable fabricated answers in LLM text-to-SQL systems.
